def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]

    def segments(n, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 4)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in segments(h, sep_rows):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in segments(w, sep_cols):
            marks = sum(
                grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != 4
                for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
            )
            row.append(1 if marks >= 2 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row)
               if all(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    # The grid dividers are the color forming complete rows and columns.
    div = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row)
               if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
               and any(all(row[c] == v for row in grid) for c in range(w)))
    background = max((v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != div),
                     key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))

    rs = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == div for x in grid[r])]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == div for r in range(h))]

    def intervals(n, cuts):
        b = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(b[i] + 1, b[i + 1]) for i in range(len(b) - 1)]

    result = []
    for r0, r1 in intervals(h, rs):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in intervals(w, cs):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != div
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(background if count == 1 else 1)
        result.append(line)
    return result
